full_track.tags: K-Pop Funk-Pop. Slap bass performs syncopated sixteenth-note patterns alongside a tight, dry drum kit. Clean electric guitar plays rhythmic muted scratches and staccato ninth chords. Bright brass section stabs punctuate the transitions. Male tenor vocals utilize a mix of chest voice and airy falsetto. Key of E Major, 115 BPM, 4/4 time signature. Synthesizer pads provide harmonic sustain in the background while a percussive cowbell accentuates the off-beats during the chorus.
